title: Idle animations and background work
intro: After market close nothing on the quote page changes, yet the app keeps redrawing, using CPU and receiving data. The main visible cause is two auto-playing carousels (Market Updates, News) that rotate forever even when they are far below the fold, plus several independent loading shimmers and spinning image placeholders. These changes keep the same features but run the animations only when someone can see them, and remove duplicated animation work. The idle network traffic is mostly caused by the live-price subscription pattern and is handled in section E.

measured.expected: about 0 fps with the carousels off screen (A1, A2)
a large drop from A1-A3; the rest depends on E1-E3 (target 3 % or less)

measured.metric: Redraw while the loading skeleton shows
measured.expected: one shimmer animation instead of up to four (A4)
not changed by this section; see E1, E2, E11, E12 (target 10 KB/min or less)

changes.title: Run Market Updates auto-play only while visible
changes.summary: The Market Updates carousel rotates every 5 s for as long as the Overview is mounted, even when it is far below the fold. Keep auto-rotation, but run it only while the carousel is on screen, its section is expanded, its route is current and the app is in the foreground, behind a Remote Config flag that defaults to today's behaviour.
changes.risk_reason: Changes when an existing animation runs. With the flag off the code path is identical to today. With the flag on, the only difference is that rotation pauses while the card cannot be seen; tap, swipe and the dot indicator are unchanged.
changes.product_decision: Market Updates keeps auto-rotating every 5 s while the user can see it. Is it acceptable that it pauses while scrolled off screen, collapsed, covered by another page or with the app in the background, and continues from the same card when it comes back?
changes.be_request: Create Remote Config boolean quote_carousel_visibility_gate_enabled (default false). Turn it on for internal users first, then 10 %, 50 %, 100 % after the idle benchmark is re-run.

files.change: Wrap the carousel in a VisibilityDetector, add lifecycle and route checks, and pass autoPlay: _shouldAutoPlay instead of true.
New: read quote_carousel_visibility_gate_enabled from FirebaseRemoteConfig with try/catch; any failure reads as false (today's behaviour).
Declare visibility_detector and firebase_remote_config, which are only transitive today (same versions as the workspace lock).

changes.current: CarouselOptions has autoPlay: true and autoPlayInterval 5 s. carousel_slider 5.1.2 starts a Timer.periodic in initState and only skips a step when ModalRoute.isCurrent is false; it does not know about scroll position, the accordion or app lifecycle. Because the Overview is one shrink-wrapped ListView inside a SliverToBoxAdapter, the carousel is mounted and painted even when it is off screen, so each 800 ms slide animation produces about 48 frames of pixels the user cannot see. With enableInfiniteScroll false it animates back to page 0 after the last card and starts again, forever.
steps: Add QuotePerfFlags.carouselVisibilityGate (Remote Config read wrapped in try/catch, default false).

In _MarketUpdatesAccordionState mix in WidgetsBindingObserver; keep _isVisible (VisibilityDetector, visibleFraction > 0.5), _isAppResumed (didChangeAppLifecycleState) and read ModalRoute.of(context)?.isCurrent in build.

Compute bool _shouldAutoPlay = !QuotePerfFlags.carouselVisibilityGate || (_isVisible && _isAppResumed && routeIsCurrent). Collapsed state needs no extra check: MOAccordion puts collapsed children in Offstage, so VisibilityDetector reports 0.
Pass autoPlay: _shouldAutoPlay. Only call setState when the value actually flips, so the CarouselSlider is not rebuilt on every visibility callback.

Use autoPlay in the options (not CarouselSliderController.stopAutoPlay): carousel_slider's didUpdateWidget calls handleAutoPlay(), which restarts a stopped timer whenever autoPlay is still true, and onPanUp() calls resumeTimer().
Use the key ValueKey('market_updates_carousel') for the VisibilityDetector; keys must be unique on the page.

changes.title: Keep carousel page index in a ValueNotifier
changes.summary: Each page change calls setState on the whole accordion, which rebuilds CarouselSlider. carousel_slider's didUpdateWidget then creates a new PageController every time. Keep the index in a ValueNotifier so only the dots rebuild, and put each carousel and its dots in a RepaintBoundary.
changes.risk_reason: Internal to two widgets. Same cards, same dots, same animation; only fewer widgets are rebuilt.

files.change: Replace int _currentIndex + setState with ValueNotifier<int>; dots built in a ValueListenableBuilder; RepaintBoundary around the carousel and the dots; dispose the notifier.
Same change.

changes.current: _onPageChange calls setState(() => _currentIndex = index). This rebuilds the Column with CarouselSlider. In carousel_slider 5.1.2, CarouselSliderState.didUpdateWidget (lines 90-104) always runs pageController = PageController(...) without disposing the old one, so the PageView re-attaches to a new scroll position on every rotation. The dot row's AnimatedContainer then runs a 300 ms animation inside the same repaint area as the carousel.
steps: Add final ValueNotifier<int> _pageIndex = ValueNotifier<int>(0); dispose it in dispose().
_onPageChange: _pageIndex.value = index (no setState).
Build the dots inside ValueListenableBuilder<int>(valueListenable: _pageIndex, ...).
Wrap the CarouselSlider in one RepaintBoundary and the dots in another.
Leave the per-tick rebuild of MarketUpdatesAccordion (overview_main.dart:683-694) to E3; it also triggers didUpdateWidget today.

changes.after_improvement: One PageController per carousel instead of a new one per rotation. Each rotation rebuilds only the dot row, and the slide repaints inside its own layer.

changes.title: Use one shimmer for the loading skeleton
changes.summary: While the quote page loads, up to four separate Shimmer widgets run at once (details, sticky tabs, overview chips, content area). Each has its own 1.5 s AnimationController and a ShaderMask layer. Safe first step: put each one in a RepaintBoundary and drop the duplicate chip shimmer. Full fix: one Shimmer over the whole page skeleton.
changes.risk_reason: The first step changes no visible pixels. The full step changes how the loading state is laid out (one skeleton instead of per-section skeletons), so the loading-to-loaded switch needs a regression pass on every asset type.

files.change: Step 1: RepaintBoundary(child: QuoteDetailsShimmer()). Step 2: pass shimmer: false when the page-level shimmer is active.

changes.current: On MoGetQuoteLoading, QuoteDetailsSection returns QuoteDetailsShimmer, StickyTabSection returns StickyTabsShimmer, QuoteContentArea returns QuoteContentAreaShimmer, and StickyChipsSection can return a second StickyTabsShimmer while isOverviewLoading. shimmer 3.0.0 gives every instance its own repeating AnimationController and pushes a ShaderMaskLayer each frame. That is about 30 fps of redraw for as long as the skeleton is shown, which on a slow open is 1.3 to 2.5 s.
steps: Step 1 (Low risk): wrap each of the four skeleton returns in a RepaintBoundary, so their repaint does not spread to the app bar or bottom bar.

Step 2: add shimmer: bool to the three skeleton widgets. In the screen, when state is MoGetQuoteLoading, wrap the scroll view in a single Shimmer.fromColors and build the skeletons with shimmer: false.
Step 2: give the CustomScrollView a GlobalKey so adding and removing the Shimmer wrapper reparents it instead of rebuilding it.
Measure the frame rate while loading (Performance overlay) before and after each step.
safety: Step 1 is pixel-identical and can ship alone.
shimmer defaults to true, so other uses of these widgets (Fundamentals tab section change, sticky chips) are unchanged.
Step 2 can sit behind the same QuotePerfFlags class as A1 if the team wants a remote rollback.
regression_checks: First open and repeat open of a stock, an index, a future and an option: the skeleton looks the same and switches to content without a flash.

changes.after_improvement: One animation controller and one shader layer instead of up to four. Expected skeleton redraw cost drops by roughly the number of removed shimmers; the redraw rate itself stays at the display rate only inside the skeleton.

changes.title: Decide what auto-play does after the last card
changes.summary: With enableInfiniteScroll: false and pauseAutoPlayInFiniteScroll left at false, both carousels animate from the last card back to the first and start again, forever. Offer Product the option to stop after one full pass (pauseAutoPlayInFiniteScroll: true), behind its own flag that defaults to today's behaviour.
changes.risk_reason: A single CarouselOptions value, behind a flag that defaults to the current looping behaviour.
changes.product_decision: After showing the last Market Updates / News card, should the carousel jump back to the first card and keep rotating (today), or stop on the last card until the user swipes?
changes.be_request: If Product chooses to stop: create Remote Config boolean quote_carousel_stop_after_last (default false).

files.change: Add pauseAutoPlayInFiniteScroll: QuotePerfFlags.carouselStopAfterLast.
Same.
